Study MBBS in Philippines

MBBS in Philippines Overview

MBBS in Philippines

With more than 7,000 islands, the Philippines is a very nature-filled country, having quite a number of beautiful beaches and historical landmarks. Its capital, Manila, amalgamates historical significance with modern facilities to create a hotspot for education and tourism.

The Philippines is a Southeast Asian country that is very famous for its beautiful islands, dynamic culture, and friendly hospitality. It is one of the main destinations among international students, especially those pursuing MBBS in the Philippines, due to the English-speaking environment and low cost of living.

The country encompasses some of the best medical colleges in the Philippines, promising quality education and practical exposure. The study of MBBS in the Philippines assures international students a safe and secure environment, combined with the opportunity to stay amidst diverse and unique cultures while studying world-class education.

Why Study MBBS in the Philippines?

A globally oriented medical route

01

MBBS in the Philippines remains among the top options for all aspirants because of very affordable tuition fees, internationally accepted courses, and teaching in the English language. All the medical colleges in the Philippines pursue an American-based curriculum and thus have a learning-outcome approach toward the education imparted so as to aim at professional doctors ready for worldwide licensure examinations, such as USMLE and FMGE.

02

The MBBS programs in the Philippines were thus tailored to maximum clinical exposure and hands-on training within hospitals to prepare the students for challenges in the field effectively. The cost of MBBS study in the Philippines is much less compared to the USA, UK, or Australia, which enables international students to make the program highly affordable.

03

The Philippines are very similar in culture to that of Indians, adding reasons to its favorable climate; hence, one of the favored destinations for students looking to study overseas. In addition, there are a number of NMC-approved medical colleges in Philippines that offer quality education with high FMGE success rates. Therefore, opting to study medicine in Philippines opens ways not only to safe and friendly higher educational opportunities but also to a gateway for highly valued careers in medicine around the globe.

All Requirements for MBBS in Philippines

Eligibility Criteria

Understand the essential criteria and requirements to ensure your eligibility for pursuing MBBS and starting your medical journey.

MBBS In Philippines Eligibility Criteria

The following are the criteria for admission to study MBBS in the Philippines:

  • Students need to have completed the 10+2 education with physics, chemistry, and biology as main subjects.
  • The candidate should have a minimum aggregate of 50% marks in PCB for the general category and 40% for reserved categories.
  • For Indian students, a valid NEET scorecard is required.
  • Must have attained the age of at least 17 years at the time of admission.
  • Proficiency in the English language is a must since the medium of instruction is in English.

Thus, the requirements in admissions for studying MBBS in the Philippines make it quite easier and more accessible to international students in general.

Required Documents For Admission In Philippines

To get admission for MBBS in the Philippines, a student needs to submit some crucial documents. General documents required for admission process for MBBS in the Philippines are:

A valid passport Mark sheet of high school NEET scorecard Birth certificate Passport photographs Proof of finance Recommendation letters Medical certificate

The above-mentioned documents are mandatory for admission to complete an MBBS program in the Philippines.

Advantages of MBBS in Philippines

Studying MBBS studies in the Philippines has a number of advantages and, therefore, is one of the most sought-after places among medical aspirants worldwide.

Affordable Education

The cost of MBBS in Philippines is way lower compared to private colleges in India, with tuition and living expenses highly manageable.

Globally Recognized

Based on the US curriculum, preparing graduates for international licensing examinations like USMLE and FMGE/NExT.

English Medium

No language barrier as instructions, course materials, and patient communication are completely in English.

High Quality & Practical

Focuses extensively on clinical rotations and direct patient interactions at modern university hospitals.

Cultural Fit

Friendly locals, tropical weather, and active Indian communities ensure a warm and comfortable stay.

Safe & Secure

Campuses offer high-end security and dedicated, well-monitored hostels for international students.

Cost of Study for MBBS in Philippines

₹25 - 35L
Estimated Total Budget Covers tuition, accommodation, & living expenses.

The cost of studying MBBS in Philippines depends upon different universities. It lies, in general, between 15-20 lakhs; hence, an approximate cost for the same. Prestigious MBBS in Philippines comes with a higher price tag and hence more costly in terms of MBBS tuition fees compared to private medical colleges in India.

The entire course cost of MBBS in the Philippines will be around ₹25-35 lakhs, including tuition fees, accommodation, and all other living expenses. This again makes the Philippines very affordable for students in their quest to pursue quality medical education at an affordable cost.

Food and Accommodation

Indian Food & Mess Vegetarian & Non-Vegetarian food is readily available on campuses.

Almost all medical colleges in the Philippines have facilities for hostels for international students. However, staying in the hostel is not compulsory but highly recommended for safety, convenience, and comfort. Some medical universities in Philippines have hostels within the campus or adjacent to the campus.

Top medical universities in Philippines even provide Indian food in their mess, covering Vegetarian as well as Non-Vegetarian tastes, which make them feel like home itself. For those who would prefer to cook for themselves, there are also some rather affordable grocery stores nearby.

Living Cost

Affordable Daily Living Expenses are roughly comparable to living in a Tier 1 Indian city.

The living cost in the Philippines is far lower compared to most Western countries, hence gaining popularity among international students. Though the living expenses related to MBBS in the Philippines are about 40% higher than in India, it remains very affordable in comparison with other countries offering the medical degree.

The transportation system in the Philippines is relatively cheap. Transportation charges are about a quarter when compared to India, and most Indian students studying MBBS in the Philippines agree to that. On the other hand, electronics in the Philippines cost about three times higher than those in India. However, clothes and shoes cost about the same as in India.

Pathway Particulars

Course Duration

5.5 to 6 years in total (Pre-med BS program + 4-year MD program + Internship).

Medium of Teaching

100% English. Both academics and clinical hospital interactions run in English.

Primary Intake

Runs from June to August annually. Limited supplementary seats in November.

MBBS in Philippines Admission Procedure

A clear admission path

  1. Fill in, completely and correctly, the online application to the chosen medical college in the Philippines.
  2. First, meet the eligibility criteria: academic eligibility is usually a high school diploma with science subjects, such as Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.
  3. Attach NEET scorecard (for Indian students).
  4. Pass the entrance examination or selection criteria of the university.
  5. Get an offer letter from the university after acceptance.
  6. Apply for a student visa to study in the Philippines.
  7. Provide all necessary documents, including academic transcripts, passport, and medical certificate.
  8. Complete the payment of tuition fees and other charges as per university guidelines.
  9. Pursue your medical studies in an NMC-approved medical college in the Philippines.

Scholarship Offered for MBBS in Philippines

The MBBS program in the Philippines is already highly cost-effective, which makes general scholarships limited but highly target-driven.

  • Merit-Based: Awarded to students with exceptional academic performance.
  • Direct Application: Applied directly to the university's financial aid board.
  • Partial Waivers: Deserving students can get tuition fee reductions.

Campus Life for Indian Students in Philippines

Enjoy a warm, safe, and multicultural campus experience designed to make Indian students feel completely at home.

  • State-of-the-art Labs: Access to modern simulation centers and digital libraries.
  • Home-Like Dining: Dedicated university messes serving Indian veg and non-veg food.
  • Safe Hostels: Secure, CCTV-monitored hostels located on or near campuses.

Career Opportunities After Graduation

Graduation opens up a variety of medical career pathways across different global healthcare ecosystems.

  • NExT / FMGE Prep: Clear licensing exams to register and practice medicine in India.
  • Global Residency: Prepare for USMLE to pursue residency and medical practice in USA.
  • Advanced Specialization: Pursue PG programs in UK, Canada, or Australia.
MBBS in Philippines Syllabus

Program phases and subjects

Pre-Med (BS Program)

Biology, General Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physics, Psychology, Mathematics, English & Communication Skills, Introduction to Human Anatomy, Basic Medical Sciences

MD Year 1

Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Biochemistry, Neuroscience, Preventive & Community Medicine

MD Year 2

Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, Parasitology, Clinical Pathology, Medical Ethics

MD Year 3

Internal Medicine, General Surgery, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, ENT, Ophthalmology, Radiology

MD Year 4 (Clerkship)

Medicine, Surgery, Psychiatry, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, Family Medicine, Emergency Medicine, Community Health

MBBS in the Philippines v/s MBBS in India

Side-by-side decision matrix

01

MBBS in India

High Costs, Limited Seats & Barriers

  • Tuition Fees: Higher, it can range from ₹40 to ₹80 lakhs, especially in private colleges.
  • Living Expenses: Higher, ranging from ₹10,000–₹50,000 per month, depending on location.
  • Eligibility: It requires higher NEET cutoff scores, especially for government colleges.
  • Medium: Some colleges use regional languages along with English.
  • Seat Availability: A very limited number of seats and very high competition, especially for governmental institutions.
  • Clinical Exposure: Limited exposure, focused on Indian healthcare systems.
  • Curriculum: Theory-based heavily, practical exposure varies from college to college.
02

MBBS in Philippines

The Smart Choice

  • Tuition Fees: Quite affordable, as the total course cost is in the range of ₹15 to ₹20 lakhs.
  • Living Expenses: Relatively low, with monthly costs at ₹15,000–₹20,000.
  • Eligibility: 50% in PCB (40% for reserved) and NEET qualification.
  • Medium & Curriculum: English medium; follows a US-based curriculum with an emphasis on practical training.
  • Seat Availability: Ample seating, less competition for admission.
  • Clinical Exposure: High clinical exposure, preparing students for global medical standards.
